messages:
Maya: Heads-up — joint summit with Nimbus + CloudScale next Wed. We have a 45min panel, 2x 20min breakouts, and a demo pit. Need owner for kit manifest + on-site courier handoff and merch staging. Who can take?
Owen: I can take kit manifest + AV cue sheet. Will sync with onsite AV tomorrow. Need speaker mic counts from you, Maya.
Maya: Speakers = 4 (panel) + 2 per breakout. Two demo stations need HDMI + power strips and 2 battery packs.
Ravi: I9ll own demo runbook and fallback. Primary on Dedicated, fallback to hosted API shim if GPUs flake. Will link runbook in GH.
Li: I can own courier + shipping windows. ETA kits to venue Tue 10am. Courier pickup Mon 4pm. Need final manifest by Mon 9am.
Tess: I9ll handle merch staging (stickers, tees, sleeves, pins). Do we have merch returns plan and on-site inventory counts?
Maya: Return bin at partner desk, Li to collect end of day. Tess, please make a CSV counts template.
Tess: Sample manifest uploaded:
Item,Qty,Pack ID
Stickers,100,PKG-001
T-shirts (M),30,PKG-002
T-shirts (L),25,PKG-002
Demo kit (HDMI+PB),2,PKG-003
Battery pack,4,PKG-003
Li: Need that by EOD so courier labeler can print docs.
Owen: AV sticky: confirm 2x wireless lav + 1x handheld for panel? If not I9ll order spares.
Maya: Confirmed 2 lav + 1 handheld. Owen, order one spare lav mic.
Ravi: Adding healthcheck for fallback: `curl -sS https://internal/health || curl -sS https://hosted.redwood.ai/shim` 1 will include in runbook.
Li: Note: battery packs are lithium-ion — courier needs HAZMAT declaration false or special handling, possible extra customs scan. I9ll prepare shipper docs.
Tess: Ordering branded lanyards — lead time 7d. If we confirm qty by EOD I can expedite to 48h for a fee.
Maya: Keep 120 lanyards, Tess please expedite.
Owen: I9ll add a short cue for each demo station to AV cue sheet with fallback note.
Ravi: Demo cue example: `Start app -> run load test (30s) -> if latency > 350ms switch to shim`.
Maya: Owners: Kit manifest & courier = Li; AV + cue = Owen; Demo runbook & fallback = Ravi; Merch staging = Tess. I9ll coordinate speaker invites and timing.
Li: Manifest v1 uploaded to drive: https://drive.company/events/summit-kits. Will update with tracking after pickup.
Owen: I9ll ping onsite AV lead tomorrow 9am PST. Maya, want a dry-run Tues 2pm PT for speakers + demo leads?
Maya: Yes — Tues 2pm PT dry-run. Add to calendar and invite Nimbus + CloudScale tech contacts.
Tess: CSV template shared in the drive. I9ll also bring backup sticker packs in an extra box.
Maya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Post blockers here. If batteries cause shipping restrictions, Li escalate and we9ll rent locally as fallback.
